review_type: Fresh independent source and saturation challenge
scope: Original 2020 base/core standard 2–4-player game, including required two-player House Hagal. Solo, variants, expansions, promos and Uprising excluded.
blinding: No summary, reader response, grade or prior reviewer report was read. The explicitly supplied coverage ledger was read.
method: Read the complete supplied main extraction and then every in-scope PDF page 1–19 using fitz text. Visually inspected PDF p18 to verify the diagram-only Sell Melange rates and board labels. Read the complete column-aware official FAQ extraction, filtered entries to original base multiplayer, and compared all 65 question wordings and expected answers against source procedures.
verdict: Not yet completely saturated: two narrow source-rule omissions remain in the questions as written. Existing keys have no material factual error found; two compressed Influence phrases should be clarified. Proposed additions may instead be incorporated explicitly into existing Q07 and board-space questions.

findings.description: Neither question explicitly tests that acquisitions may be interleaved with Reveal effects. Q07 asks the four steps, whose boxes apply and cleanup; its key permits effects in any order and mentions acquisitions without specifying their relative timing. Q08 tests replacement purchases, pooling/splitting, carryover, immediate card use and Acquire timing. A response that always completes all Reveal effects before making any purchase can satisfy both keys. The source expressly allows acquiring before, between or after Reveal effects. This is a distinct timing permission, not a new quantity example.

The general matching-icon rule is tested, but the board access map is only partly tested. Q24 explicitly tests Sietch Tabr as City and Q28 Sell Melange as Spice Trade. Q25 asks Combat classification, and Q26–30 ask costs/effects/benefits, not Agent-icon classification. In particular no question requires Research Station to be City, Mentat/Rally Troops/High Council/Swordmaster/Hall of Oratory to be Landsraad, or Secure Contract and all three Maker spaces to be Spice Trade. These are distinct legal-placement facts in the Board Space Guide; the access icon is not a board effect.

Q14 expected_answer begins “2VP threshold gives1” and Q53 says “one above2VPspace.” The source means 2 Influence, which awards one VP. The surrounding answers indicate the intended rule correctly, so this is compressed wording rather than an established material key error. Replace with “At 2 Influence, gain 1 VP” and “the space immediately above the 2-Influence space that awards 1 VP.”

The ledger coverage_map still names Guild Envoy among base FAQ p2 coverage, although its own rejected list and corrected Q52 appropriately exclude it as Uprising. Remove this stale name; do not reintroduce a question about Guild Envoy.

proposed_questions.question: During a Reveal turn, must you finish resolving all Reveal effects before spending Persuasion to acquire cards, or may you acquire cards before or between those effects as well?
proposed_questions.fixed_answer: You may spend Persuasion already gained to acquire cards before, between, or after resolving your Reveal effects. You may resolve Reveal effects in any order, and each acquisition still requires enough available Persuasion.

source_references.passage: Resolve Reveal Effects expressly permits acquisition before, between, or after Reveal effects.

proposed_questions.novelty: Distinct source-stated timing permission absent from Q07/Q08 requirements. It does not introduce another arithmetic case or merely combine existing card effects. It can be added as an explicit clause to Q07 instead of a new numbered item.

proposed_questions.question: Under ordinary Agent-icon matching, which base-game board spaces are accessible with City, Landsraad, or Spice Trade icons?
proposed_questions.fixed_answer: City: Arrakeen, Carthag, Research Station, Sietch Tabr. Landsraad: Hall of Oratory, High Council, Mentat, Rally Troops, Swordmaster. Spice Trade: The Great Flat, Hagga Basin, Imperial Basin, Secure Contract, Sell Melange. Matching the icon does not waive costs, requirements, occupancy, or once-per-game restrictions.

source_references.passage: Matching Agent icon required by Agent Turn; each Board Space Guide entry specifies its Agent icon.

proposed_questions.novelty: Covers previously unrequired board-space access classifications. Q04 gives the matching rule without the mapping; Q25 gives a different classification (Combat status); cost/effect questions do not require naming the access category. Already-tested Sietch Tabr and Sell Melange are included only to make the access sets complete; the remaining mappings are the new content.
